# Seedscape

> Seedscape turns any text (a "seed") into a deterministic, optionally animated wallpaper. 35 generative styles, a free image API (PNG, JPEG, WebP, animated WebP/GIF), a fullscreen live-wallpaper page and a browser generator. Open source (MIT), no accounts, no cookies.

- Same seed and options always produce the same image.
- Image API: GET https://seedscape-azure.vercel.app/api/wallpaper?seed=hello&style=aurora&size=1200x400 (add animate=1 for a looping animation). No API key.
- Machine-readable catalogue of styles, palettes and limits: https://seedscape-azure.vercel.app/api/styles

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://seedscape-azure.vercel.app/): overview and live style gallery
- [Generator](https://seedscape-azure.vercel.app/app): create, animate, download and share wallpapers
- [API docs](https://seedscape-azure.vercel.app/docs): full parameter reference with examples
- [Live wallpaper](https://seedscape-azure.vercel.app/live): fullscreen animated wallpaper
- [Source code](https://github.com/mskraban/seedscape): MIT licensed
